remarks: Spectacular estate in highly coveted Westover delivering luxury, scale, and versatility at every turn. Boasting 6 bedrooms and 5.5 baths, this exceptional home is designed to meet a wide range of needs-from comfortable everyday living to hosting grand, unforgettable events. Freshly painted throughout, it showcases a crisp, modern feel while maintaining timeless elegance. Built for entertaining, the expansive layout offers seamless flow between gracious living spaces, creating the perfect setting for everything from intimate dinners to large celebrations. Step outside to breathtaking, resort-style grounds highlighted by a stunning pool-your own private oasis where every day feels like a getaway. This is not just a backyard, it's a destination. Ideally located just minutes from Stamford's premier dining, shopping, and entertainment, as well as I-95, the Merritt Parkway and Metro-North, convenience and accessibility are unmatched. Homes of this caliber, in this location, rarely come to market-an extraordinary opportunity to own one of Westover's finest.
